answer: Each identity posts a key-signed commit hash of its work to a ledge, locking 50 credits; the same velvet key signs the reveal, one key one commit per epoch. Mismatch or silence burns the 50. Anyone can recompute the hash against the ledge entry; a caught copy triggers a ripple audit burning every shared reveal. The kth fake locks 50 plus a 5 fee: 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 and pay 5,000. A commit-rental ring fails: a rented commit under another velvet key is rejected, both bonds burn; an honest identity posts one commit, pays 5, and recovers its bond after a clean reveal.
